text_en: Concerning Moab. Thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: Alas for Nebo, it is laid waste! Kiriathaim is put to shame, it is taken; the fortress is put to shame and broken down;
text_cn: 关于摩阿布： 万军的上主，以色列的天主这样说：“祸哉，乃波！因为她遭受了浩劫；克黎雅塔殷蒙受了羞辱，被人攻占；城堡被人侮辱，饱受惊恐。

text_en: the renown of Moab is no more. In Heshbon they planned evil against her: “Come, let us cut her off from being a nation! ” You also, O Madmen, shall be brought to silence; the sword shall pursue you.
text_cn: 摩阿布的夸耀不再存在，在赫市朋就有人对她蓄意谋害：“来，我们将她铲除，使她不再是个民族！”连你玛德门，也要遭受蹂躏，在你后面紧随着刀剑。

text_en: Hark! a cry from Horonaim, “Desolation and great destruction! ”
text_cn: 由曷洛纳因传来哀号的声音：蹂躏！绝大的蹂躏！

text_en: “Moab is destroyed! ” her little ones cry out.
text_cn: 摩阿布遭受了蹂躏，哀号之声直达祚阿尔。

text_en: For at the ascent of Luhith they go up weeping bitterly; for at the descent of Horonaim they have heard the distressing cry of anguish.
text_cn: 他们哭泣着攀登路希特山坡；在曷洛纳因斜坡上，人们可听到凄惨的悲号：

text_en: Flee! Save yourselves! Be like a wild ass in the desert!
text_cn: 请你们逃跑，拯救你们的性命！愿你们有如旷野中的杨柳！

text_en: Surely, because you trusted in your strongholds and your treasures, you also shall be taken; Chemosh shall go out into exile, with his priests and his attendants.
text_cn: 正因你信赖你的工作和财富，你也要被占领；革摩士与自己的司祭和执事， 也要一同充军。

text_en: The destroyer shall come upon every town, and no town shall escape; the valley shall perish, and the plain shall be destroyed, as the Lord has spoken.
text_cn: 正如上主说了：蹂躏者必踏遍所有的城市，无一可以幸免；山谷必遭破坏，平原必受摧残。

text_en: Set aside salt for Moab, for she will surely fall; her towns shall become a desolation, with no inhabitant in them.
text_cn: 你们给摩阿布立墓碑，因为她已全被消灭，她的城邑全化为无人居住的荒野。──

text_en: Accursed is the one who is slack in doing the work of the Lord ; and accursed is the one who keeps back the sword from bloodshed.
text_cn: 那怠慢执行上主工作的，是可咒骂的；那制止自己的刀剑见血的，也是可咒骂的。──

text_en: Moab has been at ease from his youth, settled like wine on its dregs; he has not been emptied from vessel to vessel, nor has he gone into exile; therefore his flavor has remained and his aroma is unspoiled.
text_cn: 摩阿布自少年就享安逸，安息在自己的糟粕上，从没有由一缸倾注到另一缸内，也从没有被掳充军，为此她的滋味仍然存在，她的香味还未改变。

text_en: Therefore, the time is surely coming, says the Lord , when I shall send to him decanters to decant him, and empty his vessels, and break his jars in pieces.
text_cn: 惟其如此，看，时日将到──上主的断语──我必给她派倾倒的人来将她倒空，倒干她的酒缸，打碎她的酒瓶；

text_en: Then Moab shall be ashamed of Chemosh, as the house of Israel was ashamed of Bethel, their confidence.
text_cn: 那时，摩阿布必因革摩士而受辱，就如以色列家因他们信赖的贝特耳而受辱一样。

text_en: How can you say, “We are heroes and mighty warriors”?
text_cn: 你们怎能说：“我们是勇士，善战的力士？”

text_en: The destroyer of Moab and his towns has come up, and the choicest of his young men have gone down to slaughter, says the King, whose name is the Lord of hosts.
text_cn: 蹂躏摩阿布者上来进攻她的城市，精锐的少年，下去遭受杀戮──名叫"万军上主"的君王的断语──

text_en: The calamity of Moab is near at hand and his doom approaches swiftly.
text_cn: 摩阿布的灾难已逼近前来，她的祸患加速进行。

text_en: Mourn over him, all you his neighbors, and all who know his name; say, “How the mighty scepter is broken, the glorious staff! ”
text_cn: 你们四邻，凡认识她声名的，都应对她惋惜说：“怎么，威能的权杖，光荣的柄杖，也被折断！”

text_en: Come down from glory, and sit on the parched ground, enthroned daughter Dibon! For the destroyer of Moab has come up against you; he has destroyed your strongholds.
text_cn: 住在狄朋的女儿！你该由荣耀中下来，坐在干地上，因为蹂躏摩阿布者已前来攻击你，摧毁你的要塞。

text_en: Stand by the road and watch, you inhabitant of Aroer! Ask the man fleeing and the woman escaping; say, “What has happened? ”
text_cn: 阿洛厄尔的居民！请你站在路旁观望，向在逃亡出走的男女探问说：“发生了什么事？”

text_en: Moab is put to shame, for it is broken down; wail and cry! Tell it by the Arnon, that Moab is laid waste.
text_cn: 摩阿布已羞愧无地，因为已经瓦解；你们应悲哭哀号，在阿尔农宣布：“摩阿布遭受了蹂躏！”

text_en: Judgment has come upon the tableland, upon Holon, and Jahzah, and Mephaath,
text_cn: 惩罚已来到了平原之地，到了曷隆、雅哈兹和默法阿特；

text_en: and Dibon, and Nebo, and Beth-diblathaim,
text_cn: 到了狄朋、乃波和贝特狄贝拉塔因；

text_en: and Kiriathaim, and Beth-gamul, and Beth-meon,
text_cn: 到了克黎雅塔殷、贝特加慕耳和贝特默红；

text_en: and Kerioth, and Bozrah, and all the towns of the land of Moab, far and near.
text_cn: 到了克黎约特、波责辣和摩阿布地远近的各城市。

text_en: The horn of Moab is cut off, and his arm is broken, says the Lord .
text_cn: 摩阿布的角已被砍下，她的手臂已被折断──上主的断语。

text_en: Make him drunk, because he magnified himself against the Lord ; let Moab wallow in his vomit; he too shall become a laughingstock.
text_cn: 请你们灌醉她，因为她自高自大，反抗上主；摩阿布必要在自己的呕吐中辗转，连她自己也要成为笑柄。

text_en: Israel was a laughingstock for you, though he was not caught among thieves; but whenever you spoke of him you shook your head!
text_cn: 以色列为你岂不是一个笑柄？难道她是被人发现在盗贼之中，为什么你一提到她，就只有摇头？

text_en: Leave the towns, and live on the rock, O inhabitants of Moab! Be like the dove that nests on the sides of the mouth of a gorge.
text_cn: 摩阿布的居民！你们该离弃城市，住在岩石间，仿佛在深谷悬崖边缘结巢的鹁（bó）鸽。

text_en: We have heard of the pride of Moab— he is very proud— of his loftiness, his pride, and his arrogance, and the haughtiness of his heart.
text_cn: 我们听说过摩阿布的骄傲，她的确骄傲无比；我们也听说过她的强横、矜夸、自大和心中的傲慢。

text_en: I myself know his insolence, says the Lord ; his boasts are false, his deeds are false.
text_cn: 我知道她狂妄，好事空谈，举动轻率──上主的断语──

text_en: Therefore I wail for Moab; I cry out for all Moab; for the people of Kir-heres I mourn.
text_cn: 为此，我为摩阿布哀哭，为整个摩阿布悲号，为克尔赫勒斯人叹息。

text_en: More than for Jazer I weep for you, O vine of Sibmah! Your branches crossed over the sea, reached as far as Jazer; upon your summer fruits and your vintage the destroyer has fallen.
text_cn: 息贝玛葡萄园！我为雅则尔痛哭，更为你痛哭；你的枝叶曾越过海洋，伸展到雅则尔；现在蹂躏者竟突然来摧残你夏季的果实和秋季的收获。

text_en: Gladness and joy have been taken away from the fruitful land of Moab; I have stopped the wine from the wine presses; no one treads them with shouts of joy; the shouting is not the shout of joy.
text_cn: 摩阿布的田园已再没有欢欣喜乐；我已使槽中无酒可榨；榨酒的不再榨酒，再也听不见欢呼。

text_en: Heshbon and Elealeh cry out; as far as Jahaz they utter their voice, from Zoar to Horonaim and Eglath-shelishiyah. For even the waters of Nimrim have become desolate.
text_cn: 赫市朋和厄肋阿肋的哀号远达雅哈兹，由左哈尔发出的呼声，直达曷洛纳因和厄革拉舍里史雅，因为尼默陵的水业已枯竭。

text_en: And I will bring to an end in Moab, says the Lord , those who offer sacrifice at a high place and make offerings to their gods.
text_cn: 如此，我要给摩阿布灭绝上高丘向神祇献香的人──上主的断语──

text_en: Therefore my heart moans for Moab like a flute, and my heart moans like a flute for the people of Kir-heres; for the riches they gained have perished.
text_cn: 为此我的心像笛箫一般为摩阿布呜咽，我的心像笛箫一般为克尔赫勒斯人呜咽，因为他们获得的积蓄，都已丧失。

text_en: For every head is shaved and every beard cut off; on all the hands there are gashes, and on the loins sackcloth.
text_cn: 人人剃光头发，人人剪去胡须，手上带有割伤，腰间系有苦衣；

text_en: On all the housetops of Moab and in the squares there is nothing but lamentation; for I have broken Moab like a vessel that no one wants, says the Lord .
text_cn: 摩阿布所有的屋顶和广场上，处处可听到哀声，因为我击碎了摩阿布，有如击碎一不中人意的器皿──上主的断语──

text_en: How it is broken! How they wail! How Moab has turned his back in shame! So Moab has become a derision and a horror to all his neighbors.
text_cn: 摩阿布崩溃得多么凄惨！你们真该嚎啕！她是多么含羞转过背来！摩阿布竟成了她四邻的笑柄和恐怖。

text_en: For thus says the Lord : Look, he shall swoop down like an eagle, and spread his wings against Moab;
text_cn: 因为上主这样说：“看，敌人好像老鹰飞翔，向摩阿布展开自己的翅膀，

text_en: the towns shall be taken and the strongholds seized. The hearts of the warriors of Moab, on that day, shall be like the heart of a woman in labor.
text_cn: 攻取了城池，占领了要塞；在那一日，摩阿布的勇士必心志颓丧有如临产的妇人。

text_en: Moab shall be destroyed as a people, because he magnified himself against the Lord .
text_cn: 摩阿布必要消灭，不再成为一个民族，因为她自高自大，反抗上主。

text_en: Terror, pit, and trap are before you, O inhabitants of Moab! says the Lord .
text_cn: 摩阿布的居民！恐怖、陷阱和罗网齐来袭击你──上主的断语──

text_en: Everyone who flees from the terror shall fall into the pit, and everyone who climbs out of the pit shall be caught in the trap. For I will bring these things upon Moab in the year of their punishment, says the Lord .
text_cn: 逃脱了恐怖的，必落在陷阱里；爬出了陷阱的，必为罗网缠住；在惩罚她的那年，我要给摩阿布召来这一切──上主的断语──

text_en: In the shadow of Heshbon fugitives stop exhausted; for a fire has gone out from Heshbon, a flame from the house of Sihon; it has destroyed the forehead of Moab, the scalp of the people of tumult.
text_cn: 逃命的人，筋疲力尽，站在赫市朋的阴影下；但是从赫市朋发出了火，从息红宫中冒出了火焰，吞灭了摩阿布的首领，和骚动子民的头目。

text_en: Woe to you, O Moab! The people of Chemosh have perished, for your sons have been taken captive, and your daughters into captivity.
text_cn: 祸哉，摩阿布！革摩士的人民！你算完了，因为你的儿子已被掳去充军，你的女儿流为囚徒；

text_en: Yet I will restore the fortunes of Moab in the latter days, says the Lord . Thus far is the judgment on Moab.
text_cn: 虽然如此，在末日我仍要转变摩阿布的命运──上主的断语。至此是关于摩阿布的判决。
